bluf: A fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia’s Banten province west of Jakarta killed at least three people and left 36 missing. A Russian cargo ship bound for Kaliningrad remained on fire off Finland after drone damage, which Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Drone attack sets Russian cargo ship ablaze in Gulf of Finland

items.text: BBC News World reported that Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland; the ship was damaged in international waters and drifted into Finnish territory.
Deutsche Welle reported that Finland’s Defense Ministry suspects a Russian helicopter violated Finnish airspace and linked the suspected incursion to an earlier drone strike on a Russian cargo ship.
France 24 reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack in central Ukraine on Saturday killed two people and wounded dozens in President Volodymyr Zelensky’s hometown.

France 24 reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said at least 14 people were missing after a Russian drone struck a five-story residential building in Dymer, in the Kyiv region, while two others were injured.
Al Jazeera reported that dashcam video captured a missile striking a residential neighbourhood in Lviv, western Ukraine.
At least three people were killed and 36 remain missing after a fire destroyed large parts of a confectionery factory in Banten province, west of Jakarta.
